watches.name: Meridian S Sand Edition
watches.description: The Specht & Söhne Meridian embodies timeless elegance with a modern mechanical heart. Inspired by the refined proportions and classical aesthetics of early 20th-century dress watches, the Meridian pays subtle homage to the design principles made iconic by the Rolex 1908—clean lines, balanced symmetry, and pure watchmaking simplicity—while standing confidently as a creation of its own. At 38.5mm in diameter and only 10mm thick , the Meridian is crafted for perfect wrist presence: slim enough to slide effortlessly under a cuff, yet substantial enough to feel purposeful. A finely textured dial, paired with polished indices and a small-seconds subdial at six o’clock, gives the watch a sophisticated and harmonious visual composition. Inside, the automatic Seagull ST17 movement delivers reliable everyday performance, offering smooth operation and dependable accuracy through a proven mechanical architecture. A sapphire crystal ensures long-term clarity and scratch resistance, while the screw-down crown enhances durability and secure handling. With its 45mm lug-to-lug length and 20mm strap width , the watch sits comfortably on a wide range of wrists. A hand-stitched leather strap and polished stainless steel case complete the look, making the Meridian a versatile companion for both formal and casual settings. Specifications Diameter: 38.5mm Thickness: 10mm Lug to Lug: 45mm Strap Width: 20mm Crystal: Sapphire Crown: Screw-down Movement: Automatic Seagull ST17 Case Material: Stainless steel Dial: Guilloché-style texture with small-seconds subdial The Specht & Söhne Meridian is a celebration of classic watch design—elegant, understated, and crafted for those who appreciate mechanical authenticity.

At 38.5mm in diameter and only 10mm thick , the Meridian is crafted for perfect wrist presence: slim enough to slide effortlessly under a cuff, yet substantial enough to feel purposeful. A finely textured dial, paired with polished indices and a small-seconds subdial at six o’clock, gives the watch a sophisticated and harmonious visual composition. Inside, the automatic Seagull ST17 movement delivers reliable everyday performance, offering smooth operation and dependable accuracy through a proven mechanical architecture. A sapphire crystal ensures long-term clarity and scratch resistance, while the screw-down crown enhances durability and secure handling. With its 45mm lug-to-lug length and 20mm strap width , the watch sits comfortably on a wide range of wrists. A hand-stitched leather strap and polished stainless steel case complete the look, making the Meridian a versatile companion for both formal and casual settings. It was cool, stylish and, primarily, a sports watch, originally unveiled under the name Seastar. It didn’t take long for Tissot to give it its own moniker, standing for ‘Precise and Robust’ and the Roman numeral for ten, meaning ten atmospheres, equivalent to 100m water resistance. The Specht And Sohne Zenith is a homage to the classic Tissot PRX. Accurate down to the last detail it is another affordable addition to the Specht and Sohne line of watches. watches.name: Scimitar 60 Gray Edition
watches.description: Sculpted steel. Slim proportions. Unmistakable presence. The Scimitar 60 is designed for those who appreciate bold geometry without unnecessary bulk. Crafted from 316L stainless steel , its sharply defined case flows seamlessly into an integrated steel bracelet, creating a clean, architectural silhouette that feels both contemporary and refined. At just 7.5mm thick , the Scimitar 60 sits remarkably close to the wrist. Its 38mm case diameter and 45mm lug-to-lug profile give it a balanced presence—substantial enough to make an impression, yet slim enough to slip effortlessly beneath a cuff. The dial is protected by a highly scratch-resistant sapphire crystal , while the minimalist two-hand display keeps the design elegant and uncluttered. Inside, a dependable Japanese ultra-thin quartz movement delivers precise, low-maintenance timekeeping while allowing the case to maintain its exceptionally slender profile. A solid 316L stainless-steel bracelet with a concealed-style butterfly buckle completes the integrated design, providing a secure and comfortable fit throughout the day. With 50 metres of water resistance , a screw crown and durable steel caseback, the Scimitar 60 combines everyday practicality with a distinctly elevated aesthetic. watches.name: Crescent Black Edition
watches.description: The Specht & Söhne Crescent blends sculptural design with understated modern elegance. Its distinctive curved case is crafted from 316L stainless steel, combining a finely brushed central surface with polished outer contours for a refined contrast on the wrist. At the centre, the textured dial creates exceptional depth and character, framed by a minimalist two-hand display that keeps the design clean, contemporary and unmistakably distinctive. Measuring 34.5mm in diameter and just 9mm thick, the Crescent has a slim, balanced profile that wears comfortably while still making a strong visual statement. A 45mm lug-to-lug measurement gives the case an elegant elongated presence, while the integrated ribbed strap tapers from 20mm at the lugs to 18mm at the buckle for a seamless fit. Protected by a durable sapphire crystal, the Crescent is powered by the dependable Swiss Ronda 751 quartz movement, offering precise, low-maintenance timekeeping. A screw crown and solid stainless-steel closed caseback complete the construction. watches.name: Mariner Purple Edition
watches.description: Specht & Söhne Mariner – Premium Automatic Dive Watch The Specht & Söhne Mariner represents a step forward in the Specht & Söhne collection—an elevated dive watch designed with enthusiast-grade construction, timeless proportions, and dependable mechanical performance. With its deep blue bezel, balanced dial layout, and refined stainless steel finishing, the Mariner blends classic maritime design with modern reliability. A Higher Standard of Craftsmanship The Mariner is built to a higher specification than standard models in the Specht & Söhne lineup. It is produced by the same specialist manufacturing partner known for crafting some of the watch industry’s most respected enthusiast-grade dive watches. This collaboration allows the Mariner to benefit from upgraded machining, superior finishing, and tighter production tolerances throughout. The result is immediately noticeable on the wrist—crisp bezel action, refined case finishing, and a level of build quality typically associated with significantly higher-priced timepieces. Reliable Japanese Automatic Movement At the heart of the Mariner beats the Japanese Miyota 8215 automatic movement, a trusted mechanical caliber known for durability and consistent timekeeping. Powered by the motion of your wrist, this automatic movement requires no battery and reflects the traditional mechanical craftsmanship watch enthusiasts appreciate. Classic Dive Watch Proportions The 39mm case diameter offers an ideal balance between vintage dive watch proportions and modern wearability. Combined with a compact 45.8mm lug-to-lug distance, the Mariner sits comfortably on a wide range of wrist sizes while maintaining a strong presence. Crafted from 316L stainless steel, the case delivers excellent corrosion resistance and durability while maintaining a clean brushed finish that complements the watch’s professional dive aesthetic. Built for Clarity and Performance The dial is protected by sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, ensuring exceptional scratch resistance and optimal visibility in bright light or underwater environments. A 120-click unidirectional dive bezel surrounds the crystal, allowing precise tracking of elapsed time. The bezel action is engineered to deliver a firm, satisfying rotation with precise alignment—an essential detail appreciated by dive watch enthusiasts. Ready for the Water Designed for serious durability, the Mariner offers 200 meters of water resistance, making it suitable for swimming, snorkeling, and recreational diving. High-contrast hands and markers ensure excellent readability, even in low-light conditions. Whether you’re exploring the ocean or navigating everyday life, the Specht & Söhne Mariner delivers dependable mechanical performance in a refined, purpose-built design. watches.name: Kaliber White Edition
watches.description: Kaliber is a study in mechanical clarity. Designed for those who appreciate engineering over excess, it blends modern minimalism with traditional horology in a way that feels both purposeful and timeless. At its heart is the Seagull ST1721 jump-hour mechanical movement —a complication that replaces the conventional hour hand with a precisely advancing hour window. The result is a dial that feels architectural and deliberate, rewarding the wearer with a quiet mechanical ritual at the top of every hour. The 39 mm case is crafted from 316L stainless steel , striking an ideal balance between presence and wearability. With a slim 10.4 mm profile and a compact 46.8 mm lug-to-lug , Kaliber sits comfortably on the wrist while maintaining a refined, contemporary stance. A screw-down crown and closed steel caseback reinforce its solid, tool-grade construction. An AR-coated sapphire crystal protects the dial, ensuring excellent legibility while minimizing reflections. The layered dial design—with its recessed textures and clean typography—adds depth without distraction, allowing the jump-hour display to remain the focal point. Finished on a textured leather strap, Kaliber is not a watch that shouts. It’s a watch that speaks quietly to those who understand mechanical intent, precision design, and understated confidence. Kaliber by Specht and Söhne — engineered time, expressed with restraint. watches.name: Contour Grey Edition
watches.description: The Specht & Söhne Contour is a thoughtfully executed homage to the celebrated NAOYA HIDA & Co. NH Type 5A , capturing its restrained elegance and architectural clarity while remaining accessible and versatile for everyday wear. Defined by its slim rectangular profile and balanced dial layout, the Contour emphasizes proportion, legibility, and timeless design. At just 7.5mm ultra-thin , it slips effortlessly under a cuff, making it equally suited to formal occasions and refined daily use. Crafted from 316L stainless steel , the case offers durability with a polished, minimalist finish. A sapphire crystal protects the dial, ensuring long-lasting clarity and scratch resistance. The carefully sized 20–24mm dial preserves the watch’s elegant proportions, while applied markers and a recessed sub-seconds register add depth without visual clutter. Paired with a supple leather strap , the Contour balances vintage inspiration with modern wearability. Offered in four dial colors — black, blue, grey, and white — each variant brings its own character while staying true to the watch’s quiet, disciplined aesthetic. Key Specifications Ultra-thin profile: 7.5mm Dial size: 20–24mm Case: 316L Stainless Steel Crystal: Sapphire Strap: Leather Dial colors: Black, Blue, Grey, White The Specht & Söhne Contour is designed for enthusiasts who appreciate fine watchmaking cues, subtle luxury, and timeless form — a refined tribute to independent horology, reimagined for today.

watches.name: Meridian Brown Edition
watches.description: The Specht & Söhne Meridian embodies timeless elegance with a modern mechanical heart. Inspired by the refined proportions and classical aesthetics of early 20th-century dress watches, the Meridian pays subtle homage to the design principles made iconic by the Rolex 1908—clean lines, balanced symmetry, and pure watchmaking simplicity—while standing confidently as a creation of its own. At 38.5mm in diameter and only 10mm thick , the Meridian is crafted for perfect wrist presence: slim enough to slide effortlessly under a cuff, yet substantial enough to feel purposeful. A finely textured dial, paired with polished indices and a small-seconds subdial at six o’clock, gives the watch a sophisticated and harmonious visual composition. Inside, the automatic Seagull ST17 movement delivers reliable everyday performance, offering smooth operation and dependable accuracy through a proven mechanical architecture. A sapphire crystal ensures long-term clarity and scratch resistance, while the screw-down crown enhances durability and secure handling. With its 45mm lug-to-lug length and 20mm strap width , the watch sits comfortably on a wide range of wrists. A hand-stitched leather strap and polished stainless steel case complete the look, making the Meridian a versatile companion for both formal and casual settings. Built for those who appreciate functional elegance, the Pilot features a 38mm stainless steel case with a domed hat sapphire crystal and anti-reflective (AR) coating , ensuring clarity in all lighting conditions. Its screw-lock crown enhances water resistance and durability, embodying the rugged reliability of true pilot instruments. The striking sunburst dial captures the spirit of the skies — detailed with luminous numerals and hands for low-light legibility and a small seconds subdial for precise timekeeping. With a dial diameter of 33mm , the balanced proportions make it equally refined for the cockpit or the boardroom. Fitted with a 20mm tapering strap (20×18mm) and measuring 44mm lug-to-lug with a slim 10mm profile , the Pilot offers exceptional comfort on any wrist. Specifications: Crystal: Domed sapphire with anti-reflective coating Movement: Seagull ST1701 Mechanical Movement Water Resistance: 50m Case Diameter: 38mm Dial Diameter: 33mm Lug-to-Lug: 44mm Thickness: 10mm Strap Width: 20mm (tapers to 18mm)

watches.name: Heritage Blue Edition
watches.description: The Heritage by Specht & Söhne pays tribute to one of the most distinctive watch designs of the early 20th century: the Vacheron Constantin Historiques American 1921 . With its off-centered dial, cushion-shaped case, and unmistakable vintage charm, the Heritage reimagines a design classic for the modern collector. Crafted with precision, the Heritage features a polished stainless-steel case, sapphire crystal, and a high-quality mechanical movement that blends reliability with sophistication. The tilted dial, with bold numerals and elegant hands, recalls the spirit of early driving watches—designed for both practicality and style. Whether worn as a statement piece or as part of a refined collection, the Specht & Söhne Heritage embodies timeless elegance and enduring craftsmanship. A true conversation starter, it honors watchmaking tradition while making it accessible to today’s enthusiasts.

watches.name: Oceanmaster Blue Edition
watches.description: The Oceanmaster by Specht & Söhne pays tribute to one of the most celebrated chronographs in horological history—the Omega Speedmaster—while delivering exceptional craftsmanship and value for today’s watch enthusiast. At its heart, the Oceanmaster is powered by the reliable Seiko VK68 Chronograph Quartz Movement , a hybrid mecha-quartz caliber that combines the precision of quartz timekeeping with the satisfying mechanical snap of a chronograph reset. This ensures both accuracy and an authentic tactile experience with every use. Crafted with a stainless-steel case, domed crystal, and carefully detailed dial, the Oceanmaster captures the spirit of the classic racing chronograph while embracing modern durability. The balanced sub-dial layout, tachymeter bezel, and clean finishing make it a versatile companion—equally suited for everyday wear, adventurous outings, or refined occasions. With its blend of heritage-inspired design and dependable Japanese engineering, the Oceanmaster is more than just a homage—it’s a timepiece built to be worn, appreciated, and enjoyed for years to come. Key Features: Seiko VK68 Mecha-Quartz Chronograph Movement Stainless-steel case and bracelet Sapphire Crystal Tachymeter bezel for sporty functionality 50m Water Resistance Elevate your collection with the Specht & Söhne Oceanmaster —a homage watch that honors history while standing proudly on its own.

watches.name: DuoVista WhiteBlue Edition
watches.description: Introducing the DuoVista by Specht & Söhne —a refined dual-faced quartz wristwatch designed to match the rhythm of your day and night. With its innovative reversible face design, the DuoVista effortlessly transitions between two distinct dials. Crafted with a premium sapphire crystal dial window and housed in a polished rectangular stainless steel case, this watch offers elegance with versatility at its core. Precision meets performance in the DuoVista , powered by a reliable quartz movement originating from Japan. With a durable 11.5mm case thickness and a water resistance rating of 5 Bar, it’s built to endure daily wear while maintaining a sleek, fashionable profile. The 20–24 mm leather band, secured with a hook buckle, ensures a comfortable yet secure fit around your wrist, with a generous 22 cm band length suitable for most. The DuoVista is more than a timepiece—it’s a statement of taste, versatility, and engineering finesse. Whether you’re dressing for business or leisure, the DuoVista adapts seamlessly to your style. Its fashion-forward yet practical design makes it ideal for the modern wearer who values both form and function. The Specht and Söhne DuoVista is a distinguished addition to any watch collection—crafted to keep pace with your lifestyle, wherever it takes you. Key Features: Sapphire Crystal Water Resistant 11.5mm Thickness Dial Diameter 20-24mm

watches.name: Regal Blue Edition
watches.description: The Specht & Söhne Regal is a refined homage to the legendary Rolex Land Dweller, designed for those who appreciate heritage-inspired design paired with dependable modern engineering. Bold yet understated, the Regal captures the spirit of adventure in a perfectly proportioned 37mm stainless steel case, with a 45mm lug-to-lug span and a slim 11mm profile—making it as versatile on the wrist as it is striking. At the heart of the Regal beats the Miyota 8215 automatic movement, renowned for its reliability and robust performance. Whether you’re navigating city streets or venturing into the unknown, this timepiece delivers timekeeping you can trust. Finished with classic diver aesthetics, crisp dial detailing, and a unidirectional bezel, the Regal balances tool-watch toughness with elegant restraint. The Specht & Söhne Regal isn’t just a watch—it’s a statement of respect for the greats that came before, and a companion for those who forge their own path. watches.name: Zenith Quartz Gold Edition
watches.description: The Specht And Sohne Zenith Quartz is a homage to the classic Tissot PRX. The Zenith Quartz model is 37mm in diameter for those who prefer a more discrete wrist presence. In 1978 the brand released the original PRX. It had a flat barrel of a case with sharp facets and a signature bracelet with large, flexible links integrated into the case. Inside was a then-technologically impressive quartz movement, making it not just timely but affordable. It was cool, stylish and, primarily, a sports watch, originally unveiled under the name Seastar. It didn’t take long for Tissot to give it its own moniker, standing for ‘Precise and Robust’ and the Roman numeral for ten, meaning ten atmospheres, equivalent to 100m water resistance. Accurate down to the last detail, the Zenith II is another affordable homage addition to the Specht and Sohne line of watches. Specifications: Sapphire Glass 316L Stainless Steel Case/Screw Crown/Steel Caseback Seiko Quartz Movement Luminous Dial and Hands Water Resistant

watches.name: Architekt Gray Edition
watches.description: The IWC Ingenieur brand first appeared in 1954 and was refreshed and advanced in 1976 with the launch of an all-new design penned by famed watch designer, Gérald Genta. This was a cushion case watch like his well-received Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, then a just few years old. It also resembled the contemporary Vacheron Constantin 222 and Omega Constellation, with which it competed. Genta designed three “SL” or “Steel Line” watches, of which only the Ingenieur was presented for sale. Specht And Sohne pay homage to the genius of Genta’s design with the Architekt. It represents the most faithful tribute to the iconic watch on the market today. Specifications : Sapphire Glass 316L Stainless Steel Case Citizen Automatic Movement Luminous Dial and Hands 50M Water Resistant

collections.name: Delta GMT
collections.description: Specht and Sohne pays tribute to the iconic Seiko Prospex. Inspired by Seiko’s 1968 model, their first GMT watch with a rotating bezel, this new limited edition remains true to the classic sports design and compact dimensions of the late-‘60s Navigator Timer. A distinctive five-row bracelet adds a touch of luxury to the watch’s timeless look. The dial features the Specht and Sohne logo, mirroring the original model’s design. The GMT, hour, and minute hands, along with the indexes, are also faithful to the Navigator Timer. With an independently adjustable GMT hand and a 24-hour rotating bezel, this elegant travel watch displays the time in three different zones simultaneously.
